issue.body:
## Outcome

Configure Polis on GCP to use Vertex AI through the governed Runtime/provider configuration path.

## Primary deliverable

One reviewed, validated GCP/Vertex AI Polis configuration path that can be operated without leaking credentials or bypassing C-SDLC lifecycle authority.

## Dependencies

- Depends on #528 being terminal. Do not bind or execute this issue until #528 is complete and its terminal truth is verified.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] #528 is terminal before execution begins.
- [ ] Polis GCP configuration uses Vertex AI through explicit provider configuration, not ambient defaults.
- [ ] Vertex AI project/location/model/credential sourcing is documented and redacted.
- [ ] Runtime/provider validation proves the configured route without printing or committing secrets.
- [ ] Failure modes distinguish missing credentials, disabled Vertex APIs, project/location mismatch, quota/auth errors, and model errors.
- [ ] Evidence captures the pre-cutover tooling canary defects found while creating this issue.

## Owned paths

- `docs/runtime/**`
- `docs/tooling/**`
- `infra/runtime-v3/**`
- `adl-runtime-kernel/**`
- `.csdlc/prepared/issues/<new-issue>/**`
- `.csdlc/evidence/<new-issue>/**`

## Stop conditions

- #528 is not terminal.
- Vertex AI setup requires exposing, copying, or committing credential material.
- GCP project/location authority is ambiguous.
- The available C-SDLC tooling cannot represent the dependency or provider credential boundary truthfully.

## Non-goals

- Do not implement #528.
- Do not perform live paid GCP calls unless explicitly authorized later.
- Do not change C-SDLC v2/v3 cutover authority.
- Do not add a mock provider as acceptance evidence.

## Canary notes

This issue was intentionally created as a pre-cutover tooling test. At creation time, C-SDLC v2 remains the sole operational authority. The desired v3/single-binary shape is a governed Rust `csdlc` command that behaves like `gh` plus C-SDLC lifecycle/state, but the currently available authoritative GitHub mutation route is still the typed v2 `csdlc-github-issue` owner. Record that as a cutover defect rather than treating this issue creation as v3 authority.
